text: Ioh.12.38. rom.10.16. , Or, doctrine: Heb. hearing.
Chap. 32. 14. mar. 9.12. , Or, he hid as it were his face from vs. Heb. as a hiding of faces from him or from vs.
Or, tormented. , Rom.4. 25 1.cor. 15. 3. , 1. Pet. 2. 24. , Heb. bruise.
Heb. hee hath made the iniquitie of vs all to meete on him.
Or, he was taken away by distresse and iudgement: but &c. , Heb. was the stroke vpon him.
Or, when his soule shall make an offring.
